suppress.notes: FP-01: npm grunt-cli is the official Grunt CLI; CVE-2017-16058 concerns the different malicious package gruntcli (without hyphen). Verified names, upstream repository and NVD description. Only observed versions and this CVE. See EXCEPCIONES.md.

FP-02: npm mongodb is the Node.js client driver, not MongoDB Server or Red Hat Satellite. These four CVEs concern server-side functionality absent from the driver. Only the observed driver versions and listed CVEs. Does not attest to server security. See EXCEPCIONES.md.

FP-03: gaze/lib/helper.js contains only the credited Lodash unique array helper, not the affected template/defaultsDeep/merge/mergeWith functions. Full source inspection and exported-function assertions retained. Exact file SHA-1; no generic Lodash suppression. See EXCEPCIONES.md.
